title: Pushing to Unreserved Dynamic Array (Geometric Reallocation)
pattern: Instantiating a dynamic array/vector with zero initial capacity and appending a predictable number of elements inside a loop.
why_bad: Triggers multiple logarithmic array resizing operations, requiring the allocator to find new heap space and copy all existing elements to the new physical location.
detection: Iterative insertion (`push`, `insert`, `extend`) into a dynamic array that was initialized without an explicit capacity hint (`Vec::new()`, `String::new()`).
counterexample: The total element count is highly unpredictable and typically stays very small (e.g., < 4 elements). `Contextual`.
fix: Instantiate the vector using `Vec::with_capacity(expected_size)` before inserting elements.
